deepLinkName.description: This parameter is deprecated. Use "payload.[name]" instead.

mediaType.description: Media type of the mailing (required only for creation)

subjectForTargetGroup.description:
Subject for a specific target group. Set "subject.[targetGroupId]" in request data (only email).

Does not work with the "Try it out" feature.

archiveEnabled.description: Toggle whether a mailing can be archived or not

iconMetaData.description:
Icon meta data. Configure "icon.[attribute]".

Does not work with the "Try it out" feature.

archivePeriod.description: Period suggesting for how long a mailing should be archived

resetReplyToAddress.description: If true, the local part of the reply-to address is reset

resetTargetedSubjects.description: If true, all target group subjects are deleted (only email)

resetDeeplinks.description: This parameter is deprecated. Use "resetPayload" instead.

resetPayload.description: If true, all payload parameters are deleted. All set parameters within this request remain (only Web Push mailings).

payload.description:
Payload parameters for Mobile Push and Web Push. Set "payload.[name]" in request data.

Does not work with the "Try it out" feature.

expiry.description: Expiry date (only push mailings, use ISO 8601 format without milliseconds, e.g. 2022-03-03T08:45:07+01:00)

image.description: Image for the Web Push message

clickAction.description: Click action for the Web Push message

icon.description: Icon for the Web Push message
